entities.name: Griffin
entities.description: A fabled race of semi-intelligent beasts resembling a cross between a bird of prey and a large cat.

entities.name: Zuberi, Golden Feather
entities.description: A legendary griffin, ancestor of Zeriam.

entities.name: Zeriam
entities.description: A descendant of Zuberi and one of the few remaining griffins of Dominaria.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: The planeswalker who phased Zhalfir out of the time stream.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Land phased out by Teferi, taking most griffins with it.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God served by skeletal griffins that catch souls.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Ixalan faction whose desire the griffins share.

entities.name: Knights of Thune
entities.description: Fight alongside an order of griffin riders on Shandalar.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose knights ride griffins.

events.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of the time stream, taking most of Dominaria's griffins with it.
events.quote: When Zhalfir was phased out of the time stream by the Planeswalker Teferi

events.summary: Ravnican griffins adapt to hunting in the streets after the oceans dry up.

relations.quote: a descendant of the legendary griffin Zuberi
Skeletal griffins also serve Athreos to catch the souls of the unwilling dead.
